title: KAFKA-21232 Apache dependencies version upgrades: Ldap Api and Directory server
body: Jira ticket: KAFKA-21232 **Details:** - Apache Ldap Api: 1.0.2 --> ~2.1.9~ 2.0.2 (_version compatible with Apache DS `2.0.0.AM26`_) - Apache Directory server: 2.0.0-M24 --> 2.0.0.AM26 - Apache `commons-text` dependency is introduced - :warning: some Java code changes were required **Rationale:** - **Apache Ldap api:** - version `1.0.2` is published in June 2018. - version ~`2.1.9` is published in September 2026.~ `2.0.2` is published in May 2021. - :information_source: related link: https://directory.apache.org/api/migration-guide.html - **Apache directory server:** - version `2.0.0-M24` is published in June 2018. - version `2.0.0.AM26` is published in February 2020. - notes: - Apache DS recent version `2.0.0.AM27` is omitted because single artefact `org.apache.directory.server:apacheds-protocol-kerberos` latest version published to Maven Central is `2.0.0.AM26` - related links: - https://directory.apache.org/apacheds - https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/org.apache.directory.server/apacheds-protocol-kerberos/2.0.0.AM26/versions - Reviewers: Luke Chen

   jackson: "2.22.3",

   jacksonDatabind: "com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind:$versions.jackson",
